- State that must survive Activity/Fragment recreation: all fields, ViewModel/LiveData/SharedPreferences/Intent extras, default values, and restoration logic.
- Lifecycle behavior, visibility changes, enabled states, and any animations/transitions.
- Any hardcoded behavior, edge cases, or ambiguity that affects the UI.
- Exact source file paths (and line numbers where useful) for each claim.

Be exhaustive and precise. At the end of the markdown, list every file you read and call out anything uncertain. Report back a concise summary plus the spec path."}
